schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The nest: a shared machine made of sieve tools (outline 16.2). Each question is a sieve; sieves can come after others. Bands are phases: preprocess, measure, postprocess. nest(reaches) assembles the bands coarsest-first with empty bands omitted; shake(assembled, subjects, fire) runs them band-outer: a preprocess sieve receives the whole subject set and returns the subset to score; a measure sieve receives one subject and cuts or passes it (0.0 or 1.0, absent when it did not fire, roll-up min()); a postprocess sieve receives each survivor and the stamps of every subject and stamps that survivor with a rank, never a cut, and the shake hands back the survivors in rank order, so a compare over all the inputs (the cheapest survivor first) runs inside the nest. The band a sieve sits in is derived from what it reads (import_sieve.phase_of), never authored.
why: Outline 16.2.2: questions that can be answered deterministically should never reach an LLM; a nest composes those questions so routing and inspection run without inference. Outline 16.2.4: its users are the inference proxy's route machine (11.4.6) and build_inspector (9.4.3), two components, so it is a shared machine under cairn/machines/ (outline 16), not a file inside the base tool. Akien 2026-09-15: the bands were built for the inference proxy, 'to pick the least expensive of the paths provided' — 'a different kind of compare operation performed on all the available inputs. if it's not like that now, that's a bug.' Akien 2026-09-29 (open-8ecde12362d6), on how the pick and the walk meet: 'i really like option c' — the shake ranks instead of cutting, the survivors stay the measure band's set, and the walk order is read from the postprocess stamps.
falsifier: A shake fires a postprocess sieve before every measure sieve has fired over every subject; a postprocess sieve does not receive the stamps of all subjects; a postprocess rank changes the survivor set; the order is not the survivors sorted by rank; BAND_NAMES names band 1 anything but measure; or a tenant's findings change bytes when the shake changes order.
learns: It does not learn: it holds no state. Its tenants own what they learn from a shake.
